Page 2.
1955, January 30.
Ven. Sister Mary Bernice, C. P.
However, there is such a thing as "red communism" stealing into convents and monasterys. Very clever young men have been knowen to offer themselves as candidates for the Order who have turned out after months - sometime after years - to have been nothing more than secret promoters of unrest and red communism. Such candidates, I have heard of and in one case at least have known to show themselves very clever and experienced and naturall y older than real promising candidates - say intheir late 20s or even middle 30s, and of course not too fervent atal, even tho at the same keeping the rule fairly to the letter. Of course, to suspect anyone definitely without a conscience observance and prayer, is a rather dangerous course. Nevertheless selfpreserva- tion and "charity beginning at home", where rightly ordered Charity always must begin; superiors especially are expected to be on the elert concerning any subject who persists in refusing tospeak to, or associate with any other member of the religious family.
Hoping that this may be satisfactory and regretting having kept you waiting so long, I hope to remain,
Sincerely yours in Christ Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
Gloly be to God!
Copy of letter in possession of: Sister Bernice Botwinski, O.P. Marywood Convent 2025 Fulton St. East. Grand Rapids, MI. 49503
